vectors.name: minimal_species_1
vectors.note: Species 1 with every other field at its minimum; the high limb is still nonzero.

vectors.name: minimal_species_2
vectors.note: Lowest ID of species 2; above every species-1 ID.

vectors.name: maximal_species_1
vectors.note: Highest ID of species 1; below every species-2 ID.

vectors.name: maximum_width
vectors.note: Every field at its widest valid value.

vectors.name: perfect_ordinary
vectors.note: Perfect condition contributes zero to the lowest segment.

vectors.name: genesis_factory
vectors.note: PR 1 Genesis shape: visual 3, sound 0, block 0, perfect.

vectors.name: condition_only_worst
vectors.note: All 43 condition bits at their worst; selectors, chance and block zero.

vectors.name: visual_16
vectors.note: The fifth visual bit, 52, directly below the chance at 53.

vectors.name: sound_16
vectors.note: The fifth sound bit, 47, directly below the visual preset at 48.

vectors.name: suffix_above_lock
vectors.note: suffix starts at bit 169, directly above the transfer lock at 155-168.

vectors.name: lock_above_minute
vectors.note: The mint minute fills bits 128-154; the transfer lock starts at 155.

vectors.name: health_across_u64_seam
vectors.note: health fills bits 181-196, across the high limb's internal u64 seam at 192 by design.

vectors.name: tier_type_below_species
vectors.note: tier ends at bit 218, directly below the species at 219.

vectors.name: chance_bits_61_63
vectors.note: The chance's top three bits fill 61-63, the last bits of the low segment; no bit is reserved.

vectors.name: lock_1
vectors.note: The shortest delay: transferable one hour after the mint minute.

vectors.name: lock_forever
vectors.note: TRANSFER_LOCK_FOREVER (u64::MAX), encoded as all 14 lock bits set.

vectors.name: species_max_minute_max
vectors.note: Species and mint minute at their maximum: bits 219-250 and 128-154 all set.

normalization.name: normalize_centering_dirs
normalization.note: Noncanonical input normalizes to the perfect_ordinary ID.

normalization.name: normalize_in_art_flags
normalization.note: Noncanonical input normalizes to the perfect_ordinary ID.
